**What this site is.** Independent, reproducible data on what AI agents actually buy and pay for: the demand-cleaned x402 index and its [market dashboard](/x402/), [seller](/x402/sellers/), [buyer](/x402/buyers/) and [price](/x402/prices/) statistics, a daily [endpoint monitor](/x402/status/), a weekly [census of AI-crawler access](/access/), and tools such as [Price comps](/x402/prices/comps) and the [AI-policy checker](/check/). [x402scan](https://www.x402scan.com) is the raw explorer; this site publishes what survives cleaning, what buyers actually pay, and who comes back.

This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) from a public repository. The x402 Clean Index uses only public data: Base chain transactions via Blockscout, and the Coinbase CDP Bazaar listing. Its [method note](https://github.com/doescodinggiteasier/wknipe-site/blob/main/docs/X402_INDEX_METHOD.md) lists every filter and known bias.

**Our own payments are excluded.** We run a paid API for the index at `api.wknipe.com`. Payments to it, and payments from our test wallet, are tagged as ours and never counted as demand.

**Our crawlers.** The endpoint monitor (`wknipe-x402-status/1.0`) sends one unpaid request per listed endpoint per day at most, ≤60 per host; the access census (`wknipe-policy-check/1.0`) reads four small files per domain once a week. Ask to be excluded: wes@wknipe.com.

**Privacy.** Visits are counted with Cloudflare Web Analytics: no cookies, no personal data, no cross-site tracking. The [AI-policy checker](check/index.qmd) keeps each domain's result for 24 hours and logs nothing about who asked.

Contact: [wes@wknipe.com](mailto:wes@wknipe.com) · [GitHub](https://github.com/doescodinggiteasier) · [RSS](/feed.xml)
